design.prompt:
A design of a single low heap of fallen masonry, to be built into a 3D game prop used as cover: two large rectangular cut-sandstone blocks lying at angles, a third block leaning against them, and a few broken chunks and rubble at the base, together forming one solid knee-to-waist-high obstacle about as wide as it is deep. Red-brown sandstone, cracked, chipped and dusty, with old soot stains. Seen from a three-quarter view, slightly from above.

Style: match the reference image's painting exactly: hand-painted grim dark-fantasy concept art, matte, gritty and aged, visible brushwork, earthy desaturated palette of red-brown sandstone, ochre dust and charcoal soot. Use the reference only for painting style, palette and material treatment; do not copy its scene or composition.

Lighting: soft, even, neutral overcast light from the front. No firelight, no colored light, no cast shadows, no dramatic highlights, so the true colors of the stone are visible.

Framing: a single object, centered, entirely in frame with margin on all sides, on a plain light grey background. No text, labels, UI, ground plane or other objects.
